metadata.description:
Hello young human, and welcome to Your Turn. 

In this interactive adventure, YOU decide what happens. As you listen to the story
unfold, you'll sometimes be asked to make choices using the left and right buttons on
your Yoto player. Each choice will take you—and the story—in a different direction.

In this story you find yourself suddenly understanding your pets, and wait…is that fur growing on your ears?  Your cat and dog have a big mystery for you to solve--and it's not just a problem with their squeaky toys. Can you help your pets save the day?

Are you ready? It's Your Turn to decide the story.

Written by Tina Connolly  

PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto Player or Yoto Mini and a physical Yoto Card to experience this Interactive Story as intended. While tracks will play sequentially in the app, listeners will not be able to make choices and, as a result, will not get the full experience. We recommend allowing the content to fully download before playing.
